updates.headline: VanEck rates Metaplanet 'Bad' on executive pay, dilution
updates.what_happened: VanEck's mid-September 2026 Bitcoin ChainCheck report singled out Metaplanet as the only company among the ten largest digital-asset treasuries it grades 'Bad' on executive compensation practices, saying its option pool equals roughly 14.7% of fully diluted shares and officer exposure is about 8.2% — far above peer averages. The report acknowledges the board's August 18 removal of the automatic pool-growth clause and the September 11 cut of the option pool by 41% to 188.2 million shares, but argues these fixes still fall short and calls for a full reversal of the roughly 273 million shares added via the prior mechanism plus a shareholder-approved replacement plan.
updates.thesis_fit: This is a direct governance/incentive-alignment critique from a reputable crypto-focused asset manager, reinforcing the checklist concern that compensation structures may not be genuinely performance-linked despite the already-reported 41% pool cut.
